## About
Rotary Power has been repairing and building rotary motors for as long as they have been in production. We specialize in the attention to detail that is needed when rebuilding or servicing your rotary.
The shop covers both machine shop work and mechanic service: porting, rotor and e-shaft work, engine and turbo rebuilds, installations and transmission work. Reviewers name Jeff as the man behind it, with one mentioning Garett and another his nephew.
We're on South Harvard Blvd in Gardena, close to the freeways. Stop by or call during regular business hours, or email us a question.

## Services
- Mild Street Port: Street porting that passes smog. ($400)
- Race Port: Porting for full power. ($500)
- Peripheral Port ($900)
- Water Passage Porting: Porting the water passages for better cooling. ($200)
- Side Clearance Rotors: Rotors ground parallel. ($75 ea.)
- Grind E-Shaft Main Bearings: Main bearings ground to race clearance. ($100)
- 93-95 Street Ported Engine: Built with new apex seals, corner seals, side seals, oil control rings, all springs, main seals and water seals, using your good core. Rotor housings are extra if needed. ($3595)

## FAQ
Q: Where is the shop?
A: On South Harvard Blvd in Gardena, no more than 5 minutes from the 405, 110 and 91 freeways.

Q: What are your hours?
A: 10 to 6, Monday through Friday. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I email a question instead of calling?
A: Yes. Email us a question and we will try to get back to you as soon as possible.
